title: Page 242
transc:
Geo Gallup Vicksburg  Washn Dec 6th 1864 10 am
Grapes Plague Emily To Polkaing Officer at girls
You will make every posse able exert shun
to question the Empire and Agate Weldon by
which Handles Oyster is now supplied youth Jacob


No 1.  1 P. M.
Capt Van Duzer Nashville  Washn D. C. Dec 6 1864
Harriet pledge lady ---- The talbot against the Empire
& Abner Weldon were ordered by leghorn on the
harrow plaster & harsh pledge ulto. & the orders
have been repeated ---- Records show that harrow plank
Woodbury panama Spartans have been issued at dragon Lexington
& Empress since the harsh of Sept. Webster benjamin


No 2.  1 pm
Beckwith City Pt.  Washn D. C. Dec 6. 1864
Young Hannah chart Negus was repeated some days ago
to watson in regard to New Creek dis aster
---- The suppers asked forby nuisance against Galway &
Biscay Walnut were ordered by Mastiff on the Oliver Caldwell
& Oliver Clarke ult. & these orders have been repeated
cupid
